content.short: Socios is a decentralized platform for building fandom.
content.description: Socios is a decentralized platform that helps sports brands deepen fan engagement through NFTs and DeFi tokens. Its NFT marketplace lets clubs list and sell fan NFTs directly to supporters, while in DeFi it creates and deploys official club fan tokens on behalf of teams. Socios has partnerships with LaLiga, Serie A, and the Champions League, reflecting its role in connecting fans with top-tier football organizations.
